query:
UPDATE applications SET name = $2, description = $3, source_kind = $4, git_url = $5,
             git_branch = $6, build_kind = $7, build_path = $8, build_context = $9, image = $10,
             deploy_key_public = $11, deploy_key_private_enc = $12, strategy = $13,
             updated_at = now()
             WHERE id = $1
